```yaml
name: Auto-approve workflows for returning contributors and ok-to-test labeled PRs

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [labeled, unlabeled]
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'  # Daily at midnight

jobs:
  auto-approve-workflows:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'

      - name: Get PR information
        id: pr_info
        run: |
          echo "::set-output name=pr_number::$GITHUB_EVENT_NUMBER"
          echo "::set-output name=pr_creator::$GITHUB_ACTOR"

      - name: Check if PR creator is a first-time contributor
        id: check_contributor
        run: |
          PR_CREATOR=$(echo ${{ steps.pr_info.outputs.pr_creator }})
          PR_COUNT=$(curl -s "https://api.github.com/repos/volcano-sh/agentcube/pulls?state=all&creator=$PR_CREATOR" | jq '. | length')
          if [ "$PR_COUNT" -le 1 ]; then
            echo "::set-output name=is_first_time_contributor::true"
          else
            echo "::set-output name=is_first_time_contributor::false"
          fi

      - name: Approve workflows if not first-time contributor or labeled 'ok-to-test'
        if: ${{ steps.check_contributor.outputs.is_first_time_contributor == 'false' || github.event.label.name == 'ok-to-test' }}
        run: |
          PR_NUMBER=$(echo ${{ steps.pr_info.outputs.pr_number }})
          curl -X POST \
            -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d '{"event_type": "workflow_dispatch", "client_payload": {"action": "approve"}}' \
            https://api.github.com/repos/volcano-sh/agentcube/dispatches
```
